# The ultimate guide to product-led sales | Elena Verna

## Transcript

Lenny (00:00:00):
Elena, how should companies think about product-led growth versus sales-led growth?

Elena Verna (00:00:20):
Product-led growth means the product itself is the main driver of acquisition, conversion and expansion. Sales-led growth relies on a sales team to drive revenue. Most successful companies end up hybrid: product-led sales, where the product generates qualified accounts and sales helps those accounts expand. The mistake is bolting a sales team onto a product-led motion without giving them product usage signals.
